Worth visiting !!
Jun 2025 • Friends
It was our first day in Hanoi. We were fifteen of us and all vegetarians. We decided to visit this restaurant after reading some positive reviews. We stated with roasted Papad, French Fries and Onion Pakodas. Few of us had beers. In main course, we had Paneer tikka, Dal Tadka and Mixed Vegetable with Rice and assorted Rotis. The food was very good. Everyone loved it.
Our server Aditya with his team was very helpful. The service was very fast. The overall ambiance was quite good.

Delighted with the changes
Apr 2025 • Couples
My wife an I often visited when it was Maazi; we live in Vinh Phuc Province and were unaware of the change until we got there. Not intending to discredit Maazi in any way, we were each happy with the subtle changes: The menu seems to offer more and the service was faster, so the food we ordered was still hot when it reached our table. I was looking for something different than my usual, so I asked Farhan for a suggestion; upon trying it, I was glad I sought his recommendation. Their black chai tea completed an awesome visit.

Insider tip:
If you're new to this cuisine, don't be afraid to ask for a recommendation; the staff will help you find the right dish.

This Indian restaurant is an absolute gem! The food is incredibly flavorful, with authentic spices and a variety of dishes that cater to every palate. The butter chicken and biryani are must-tries, perfectly cooked and rich in taste. The staff is welcoming and attentive, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. The ambiance is cozy, with traditional decor adding to the cultural vibe. Whether you're a fan of Indian cuisine or trying it for the first time, this place is a fantastic choice. Highly recommended for a memorable meal!
